note:
The reduced-accumulate expectation on a register row too wide to hold its partials whole. At head width 256 the value product spans the head in one warp column of 32 fragments: the f32 carrier takes 128 registers and the hoisted query 64, so 32 live f16 partials (64 more) put the thread past its 255-register envelope. The schedule was refused outright, and with the refusal lifted by hand it ran 40.2 us against the f32 cell's 38.1 on an RTX 5090.

The chunk drains one column pair through every key step and folds it at once, so two partials are live instead of the row. The pin realizes, the paired ldmatrix loads survive, and the same row measures 38.2 us.

attrs.body:
let f32 v0 = 0.0625
in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_fill_c[0]
in1 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_zero_c[0]
for a0 in 0..16:
    for a1 in 0..512:
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a3 in 0..256:
                in2 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a3]
                in3 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a3]
                f32 v1 = multiply(in2, in3)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v1) over a3
            v2 = multiply(acc1, v0)
            v3 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a1
                in0 when a1 < a2
            v4 = add(v2, v3)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v4) over a2
        for a2 in 0..512:
            for a5 in 0..256:
                in4 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a5]
                in5 = load x1[0, a0, a2, a5]
                f32 v5 = multiply(in4, in5)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v5) over a5
            v6 = multiply(acc3, v0)
            v7 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a1
                in0 when a1 < a2
            v8 = add(v6, v7)
            v9 = subtract(v8, acc0)
            v10 = exp(v9)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v10) over a2
        for a6 in 0..256:
            for a7 in 0..512:
                for a8 in 0..256:
                    in6 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a8]
                    in7 = load x1[0, a0, a7, a8]
                    f32 v11 = multiply(in6, in7)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v11) over a8
                v12 = multiply(acc5, v0)
                in8 = load x2[0, a0, a7, a6]
                v13 = select:
                    in1 when a7 <= a1
                    in0 when a1 < a7
                v14 = add(v12, v13)
                v15 = subtract(v14, acc0)
                v16 = exp(v15)
                v17 = divide(v16, acc2)
                v18 = multiply(in8, v17)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v18) over a7
            scaled_dot_product_attention[0, a0, a1, a6] = acc4
